# Controlled Nonplayer Motion Prefix

The manifest and compressed oracle freeze independently observed original
7018..732C execution. They contain compact actor/local/animation projections,
not full RAM images or screenshots. The fixture checker authenticates all
transitive producer and canonical asset hashes.

The decoded LZNPM001 stream has a 44-byte header and 6,569 fixed 654-byte rows:
original case ID and domain, 585 input bytes, and 64 result bytes. The typed
reader pins the complete stream fingerprint and validates coverage/extent.
The API replays every row. The App comparison admits only behavior 3/4 and
reports exclusions. This does not claim natural or whole-frame parity.

See docs/recovery/nonplayer-motion-app-20261019.md for the evidence boundary,
before/after App result, faults, provenance and remaining gaps.
